notes: Day 26 concludes: St. Timon's martyrdom concludes from page 104 (¶፭ joined with 'አኀዞ ለቅዱስ ጢሞና ወአኰነኖ ኵነኔ ጽኑዐ...'), followed by doxology ¶፮ ('ወስብሐት ለእግዚአብሔር...'). Arke hymn for St. Timon ('ሰላም ለጢሞና እምኍልቈ ሰብዓ ወክልኤቱ አርድእት...'). Commemoration ¶፯ for St. James the brother of the Lord, Philip, and Amanatios the martyr ('ወበዛቲ ዕለት ተዝካሮሙ ለያዕቆብ እኁሁ ለእግዚእነ...'). Day 27 (ጥቅምት ፳ወ፯) opens with commemoration of Abba Macarius Bishop of Qaw (አባ መቃርስ ኤጲስቆጶስ ዘሀገረ ቃው): ¶፩-፬. Paragraph 4 finishes completely at the bottom of the page, followed on page 106 by ¶፭ ('ወካልዕተ ጊዜ ርእየ...'). Line-by-line verified against page_105.png.
